tokens.name: tablecloth-red
tokens.usage: Gingham red: the solid squares of the tiled tablecloth background, its CSS fallback, the cover.

tokens.name: tablecloth-pink
tokens.usage: Gingham half-tone: where one red stripe crosses white. Fallback pattern and cover only.

tokens.name: tablecloth-white
tokens.usage: Gingham white squares. Fallback pattern and cover only.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The content wrapper floating on the tablecloth: slightly yellowed white, like an old monitor. Posts sit on it.

tokens.name: box
tokens.usage: Sidebar box bodies, the recipe box, comment backgrounds (the classic 'cornsilk').

tokens.name: box-border
tokens.usage: 1px borders of sidebar boxes, recipe box, comments, and the dashed post dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: box-head
tokens.usage: Title bars of sidebar boxes and table headers; the nav bar. Put `on-box-head` text on it (9.3:1).

tokens.name: on-box-head
tokens.usage: Text on `box-head` and on the banner's dark end.

tokens.name: banner-start
tokens.usage: Left end of the header banner's horizontal gradient. Title and subtitle sit on this end.

tokens.name: banner-end
tokens.usage: Right end of the header banner's gradient (the 'sunset' orange). No text over this end.

tokens.name: banner-title
tokens.usage: The WordArt-yellow blog title in the banner, always with the hard black `text-shadow` (8.5:1 on `banner-start`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on `page`, `box`, `note-bg`, `chrome` (14:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines ('Beküldte: Ödön | …'), timestamps, footer small print, on `page` and `box` (5.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: post-title
tokens.usage: Post titles and the critic's headings on `page` (9.1:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Every link, always underlined, on `page` and `box` (8.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: link-visited
tokens.usage: Visited links. Yes, really purple.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover: turns red and loses the underline, the 2000s way (5.4:1 on `page`).

tokens.name: note-bg
tokens.usage: Ödön's personal-note box ('Szerk. megj.:'), the yellow sticky.

tokens.name: note-ink
tokens.usage: Comic Sans text in the note box (6.3:1 on `note-bg`).

tokens.name: marquee-bg
tokens.usage: The scrolling welcome strip under the banner.

tokens.name: marquee-ink
tokens.usage: Marquee text on `marquee-bg` (5.6:1); also the 'ÚJ!' badge fill, with `new-ink` text.

tokens.name: new-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the red 'ÚJ!' badge (5.5:1 on `marquee-ink`).

tokens.name: led-bg
tokens.usage: Visitor counter display and the digicam photo frame shadow.

tokens.name: led-ink
tokens.usage: Visitor counter digits on `led-bg` (15:1).

tokens.name: datestamp
tokens.usage: The orange digicam date burned into photo corners, with a dark 1px text-shadow.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Windows-98 grey: buttons, form fields' frames, the poll results track. `ink` on it is 13.7:1.

tokens.name: chrome-light
tokens.usage: Top-left highlight of the bevel.

tokens.name: chrome-shade
tokens.usage: Inner bottom-right shade of the bevel; form-field borders (3.9:1 on `page`).

tokens.name: chrome-dark
tokens.usage: Outer bottom-right edge of the bevel.

tokens.name: lightbox-backdrop
tokens.usage: The dark screen behind an enlarged photo (the Lightbox 2 look). Only `Lightbox` uses it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 1px dotted black outline, offset 2px, like old browsers drew it. Solid 2px on `box-head`-free surfaces is fine too.

styles.name: blog-title
styles.usage: The banner title only, in `banner-title` with a hard 3px black shadow.

styles.name: post-title
styles.usage: Post titles in `post-title`. Linked titles stay this colour.

styles.name: box-title
styles.usage: Sidebar box title bars, uppercase, `on-box-head` on `box-head`.

styles.name: post-body
styles.sample: Kedves Olvasóim! Ma egy olyan ételről kell írnom, amelyről nem szívesen írok.
styles.usage: Post text. The one place readability wins: 13px with generous leading.

styles.name: sidebar
styles.usage: Sidebar box content, comments, the recipe box.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Post meta lines and comment headers, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Footer lines and the satire notice. Never below 10px.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Szerk. megj.: ezt a receptet a szomszéd hozta át. Nem fogom elfelejteni.
styles.usage: Ödön's asides and P.S. lines, in `note-ink` on `note-bg`.

styles.name: datestamp
styles.usage: The digicam date in a photo corner, in `datestamp`.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Text inside 88×31 web badges only (the 'ÚJ!' tag uses 9px). Decorative; never the only place information lives.

spacing.note: Odd pixel values, as hand-written in 2008. Do not round them to a 4 or 8 grid.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between 88×31 badges; cell padding in tight tables.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Box body padding, meta line spacing, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Wrapper padding, gap between sidebar boxes, post paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Gutter between the post column and the sidebar.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Space between posts (above the dashed divider).

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Space above the wrapper on the tablecloth, and below the footer.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything, by default.

tokens.name: radius-web20
tokens.usage: The one 'Web 2.0' rounded box: the poll. Ödön read about rounded corners in 2007 and used them exactly once.

shadow.note: Hard shadows and Windows-98 bevels. No blur anywhere.

tokens.name: bevel-out
tokens.usage: Raised Win98 surface: buttons at rest, the counter frame.

tokens.name: bevel-in
tokens.usage: Sunken surface: pressed buttons, text fields, the poll track.

tokens.name: drop-hard
tokens.usage: The content wrapper's hard drop shadow on the tablecloth. Also on photos.

tokens.name: page-width
tokens.usage: Width of the content wrapper. Fixed above 800px; fluid below (the one modern concession).

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: The post column.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The right sidebar column.

tokens.name: photo-width
tokens.usage: Default digicam photo width (the camera's 'web' setting).

tokens.name: thumb-width
tokens.usage: Photo thumbnail next to a post excerpt on listing pages.

tokens.name: lightbox-width
tokens.usage: Largest size of an enlarged photo: the camera file's own 640×480, never more.

tokens.name: share-width
tokens.usage: Open Graph share card width (`ShareCard`, /og/*.jpg).

tokens.name: share-height
tokens.usage: Open Graph share card height.

tokens.name: tile-size
tokens.usage: Size of the tablecloth background tile (two 24px gingham cells).
